from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and case cause."""
    document_id: str = Field(description="Document identifier, e.g., '判决文书1'")
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal case cause (案由) as stated in the document")
    is_administrative_penalty: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document involves administrative penalty (行政处罚); inferred from the document content")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
